meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会引导你为某个频道创建第一个 NanoClaw agent:确认你在该频道的身份、新建 agent、把 DM 消息组接好,再让 agent 通过正常投递路径给你发一条欢迎私信。重复运行不会重复创建。
howto.when: 在频道凭证已配置、服务正在运行、且目标频道已安装后使用;前提是已经跑过 /add-discord、/add-slack 等 /add-<channel> 技能。

say.text: 帮我给 Telegram 频道创建第一个 NanoClaw agent
say.note: 会依次问你频道、用户 ID 和显示名

say.text: 我的用户 ID 是 123456789,显示名就叫小明
say.note: 补上身份后脚本开始创建并接线

say.text: 欢迎私信一直没到,帮我看看卡在哪了
say.note: 会查 outbound 数据库和日志定位

howto.what_en: Claude walks you through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a channel: resolving your channel identity, creating the agent, wiring its DM messaging group, and sending you a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Reruns are safe.
howto.when_en: Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, with at least one /add-<channel> skill already run. The skill is idempotent.

say_en.text: Create the first NanoClaw agent for my Telegram channel
say_en.note: It asks for channel, user ID and display name

say_en.text: My user ID is 123456789 and my display name is Sam
say_en.note: The script then creates the agent and wiring

say_en.text: The welcome DM never arrived, help me debug
say_en.note: Checks the outbound DB and logs
